projects.name: Project Manager
details: • Communicate, and Track Project lifecycle activities from concept, product delivery, UAT
• Implementation activities to meet business deadlines and comply with IT governance policies and processes.
• objective is to create visibility of BSG projects to project stakeholders and complete activities within mutually
agreeable timelines through handoffs, signoffs, updates, and follow-up
• Responsible for documenting and getting user concurrence on Functional Requirements Specification,
Operations Process Design of Business user requirements through conducting requirements elicitation,
analysis, discussions, and sign offs
• Ensure that Requirements are captured “First Time Right” from the user and documented into cost effective,
efficient TO-BE processes by reducing process redundancies and deficiencies.
• Communicate to stakeholders through efficient documentation in -order to get agreement on solutions
meeting the requirements
• Observe, Interact with Users, System owners and Document AS -IS business processes in a domain and
identify process improvements and pain areas. Discussion on Pain Areas with Process Owner
• Follow up with Process Manager and BSG Team for implementation of Pain Areas, Implementation of each
Pain Areas in the process identified, Update progress of each Pain Area for solution /enhancement
implemented, ensure proper flow of Process post implement ation, Document any change / up -gradation of
process
